requirements.statement: Harness V2 reclaims local work branches and remote queue branches with compare-and-swap once their immediate purpose ends, without creating permanent runtime evidence refs.

criteria.statement: Successful queue construction removes the exact local work branch after its reviewed payload is represented by the temporary queue candidate.
negative_definitions: Deleting a work branch before the temporary queue candidate exists does not qualify.
Deleting a branch whose SHA changed after review does not qualify.
Leaving a completed task work branch indefinitely does not qualify.

criteria.statement: Successful publication, cleanup recovery, explicit queue rejection, reopen, and bootstrap publication delete the exact remote and local queue ref with compare-and-swap semantics.
negative_definitions: Deleting a queued candidate before publication or an explicit reject or reopen action does not qualify.
Deleting a queue ref that moved to another SHA does not qualify.
Creating an archive ref for a rejected temporary candidate does not qualify.
Treating a failed cleanup as successful does not qualify.

criteria.statement: An idempotent branch GC command reports and reclaims only unattached work refs or queue refs already reachable from protected history.
negative_definitions: GC recognizing any permanent approval, state, submission, attestation, or archive namespace does not qualify.
GC deleting an active or queued task candidate does not qualify.
GC relying on branch age or name without evidence does not qualify.
GC defaulting to destructive execution does not qualify.
